Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

  3) If PO path: procurement will need invoice remit details and Redwood’s vendor code; I’ll loop in Finance once you confirm (David / Marissa).

I’m attaching the vendor setup packet and our current W-9 for AP intake so you can share with procurement. Let me know if you prefer these via a DocuSign packet or direct upload to your vendor portal.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Setup_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9_2026.pdf
